items.title: Judge orders Trump admin to stop threatening election officials
items.feedTitle: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
items.summary: A federal judge has ordered the Trump administration to cease threatening U.S. election officials. The order comes as the Department of Justice has been using a list of alleged noncitizens to threaten prosecution of state election officials. Analysis found that over 40% of names on the DOJ's list are not on California voter rolls, and thousands of U.S. citizens appear to be erroneously flagged as ineligible. The ruling represents a judicial check on executive intimidation of election administrators.

items.title: ICE agent caught on video pointing gun at bystander during arrest
items.feedTitle: Video showing federal agent pointing handgun in face of bystander sparks outrage
items.summary: Video footage shows a federal immigration agent pointing a handgun at a bystander's face during a tense arrest in North Hollywood. The incident occurred during what authorities describe as an immigration enforcement operation. The video has sparked public outrage over the use of force and the endangerment of uninvolved civilians during law enforcement activities.

items.title: Pregnant woman killed, six injured in Spirit Halloween shooting
items.feedTitle: Fairfield mass shooting: Pregnant woman killed, 6 others hurt at Spirit Halloween store
items.summary: A mass shooting at a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California left a 31-year-old pregnant woman dead and six others injured. The incident represents another outbreak of gun violence at a retail location. Authorities are investigating the shooting and have identified the victim.

items.title: Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire allows Oleshky evacuees to return
items.feedTitle: Evacuees from Russia-controlled Oleshky arrive back in Ukraine amid U.S.-brokered ceasefire
items.summary: Ukrainian residents evacuated from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have been reunited with their families after crossing into Ukrainian-held territory under a localized ceasefire agreement secured by First Lady Melania Trump. The evacuation operation follows weeks of devastating warfare in the region. The temporary halt in fighting, which began in early November, is set to last through the weekend.

items.title: Heavy rains threaten flooding in already saturated Southwest
items.feedTitle: Heavy rains expected to bring flooding risk to already saturated parts of the US Southwest
items.summary: The U.S. Southwest faces additional flooding risk as heavy rains are expected to impact already water-saturated regions. Communities in the Southwest are bracing for severe weather this weekend following weeks of devastating storms. The rainfall could exacerbate existing flood conditions across vulnerable areas.

stlouis.title: St. Louis selected for major DOJ crime funding initiative
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Selected for Major DOJ Crime Funding
stlouis.summary: St. Louis has been selected to receive significant Department of Justice funding to address crime in the region. The selection underscores ongoing federal efforts to support local law enforcement and public safety initiatives in areas with elevated crime rates. Details on the funding amount and specific programs remain under development.

stlouis.title: St. Louis County early voting surpasses 2022 midterm total turnout
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis County early voting surpasses total turnout for 2022 midterms
stlouis.summary: Early voting in St. Louis County has already exceeded the total turnout from the entire 2022 midterm election cycle, indicating heightened voter engagement ahead of the 2026 midterms. The surge reflects strong participation across the region as voters cast ballots early.

stlouis.title: UMSL program helps educators prepare for AI-driven future
stlouis.feedTitle: UMSL program helps St. Louis-area educators prepare students for AI-driven future
stlouis.summary: The University of Missouri–St. Louis has launched a program to help area educators prepare students for an increasingly AI-driven workplace and society. The initiative reflects growing recognition of the need to equip students with skills relevant to artificial intelligence integration across industries.

items.title: Iran's supreme leader orders maximum response to any attack
items.feedTitle: Iran's leader says response to attack would have no 'geographic limits,' and other Mideast news
items.summary: Iran's supreme leader has ordered the military to prepare a 'maximum response' to any U.S. or Israeli strikes, with senior military officials warning that retaliation would have no geographic limits. The escalating rhetoric follows reports of potential renewed U.S. military strikes on Iran after the midterm elections. Iran says it is ready to strike first if it believes an American attack is imminent.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands march in third weekend of French protests
items.feedTitle: Thousands demonstrate in Paris as protests spread across Europe
items.summary: More than 320,000 people demonstrated across France over the weekend in a third consecutive wave of protests against rising cost of living and deteriorating public services. Some clashes erupted between protesters and police, with authorities deploying over 70,000 police and gendarmes. Similar youth-led demonstrations have spread across Europe, including Germany, where some turned violent.

items.feedTitle: Oleshky evacuees reunite with families after truce allows crossing back into Ukraine
items.summary: Residents evacuated from the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky have crossed into Ukrainian-held territory and reunited with families under a temporary U.S.-brokered ceasefire. The evacuation convoy was greeted by residents lining highways waving flags. Many evacuees had endured extreme hardship including lack of food, water, and electricity during their time in the occupied city.

items.title: INDIA bloc holds mega rally against election commission chief
items.feedTitle: INDIA Bloc to hold mega rally against CEC, SIR today; leaders, supporters begin arriving in Delhi | LIVE
items.summary: India's opposition INDIA bloc held a massive rally at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi, with over 250 opposition MPs symbolically 'impeaching' Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on six charges. The demonstration was prompted by allegations that a voter roll revision exercise has deleted names of approximately 130 million voters from electoral rolls. Opposition leaders and constituents shared accounts of voters allegedly disenfranchised by the electoral revision process.

items.title: Quad announces $85 million to expand AI access in Indo-Pacific
items.feedTitle: Quad flags economic coercion, announces $85 million to expand AI access
items.summary: The Quad (India, US, Japan, Australia) has announced an $85 million initiative to expand artificial intelligence access and capability across the Indo-Pacific region. The announcement also flagged concerns about economic coercion by China. The funding aims to strengthen technological capability and resilience in partner nations.

items.title: J&K CM Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan
items.feedTitle: J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan
items.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has married journalist Nidhi Razdan in a private ceremony. The announcement comes amid reported internal tensions within Abdullah's National Conference party, with roughly half of MLAs challenging the leadership. The marriage marks a significant personal milestone for the state's chief executive.

items.title: ISRO successfully launches NVS-03 navigation satellite
items.feedTitle: ISRO NVS-03 launch: 5 things to know about India’s new navigation satellite
items.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite using the GSLV-F18 rocket, restoring the NavIC constellation to four operational satellites. The satellite is part of India's indigenous navigation system development. The launch reinforces India's capability in space-based positioning and navigation infrastructure.

items.title: PM Modi inaugurates Kashi-Delhi Vande Bharat sleeper train
items.feedTitle: 'Historic day': PM Modi welcomes launch of Kashi-Delhi Vande Bharat sleeper train
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has flagged off a new Vande Bharat sleeper express train connecting Varanasi and Delhi, calling it a 'historic day' for Indian rail infrastructure. The train represents an upgrade in India's rail connectivity between two major cities. Modi also inaugurated related transportation projects worth over ₹400 crore on National Unity Day.

immigration.title: Indiaspora warns proposed H-1B visa curbs could hurt US economy
immigration.feedTitle: Indiaspora warns proposed H-1B visa curbs could hurt US economy
immigration.summary: Indiaspora, an advocacy group representing Indian-origin professionals, has warned that proposed curbs on H-1B visa usage could damage the U.S. economy. The group is responding to policy proposals, not yet finalized, that would restrict access to or use of H-1B visas by employers. The warning comes as the Trump administration has signaled intent to review visa programs, but no final rule has been published.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows EB-3 advances for Indian applicants
immigration.feedTitle: US Visa Bulletin November 2026: EB-2 unchanged, EB-3 Green Card dates advance for India
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin released by the State Department shows modest advances in employment-based green card priority dates. For Indian applicants in the EB-3 category, there was forward movement on final action dates, though EB-2 dates for India remained stuck in 2013, showing minimal progress. EB-1 dates also remained unchanged. The bulletin indicates USCIS will continue accepting dates for filing in most employment-based categories.

immigration.title: Court blocks reopening of 2027 diversity visa green card lottery
immigration.feedTitle: Green Card lottery 2027 stays closed: what the appeals court ruling means and what happens next
immigration.summary: A federal appeals court has blocked the reopening of the FY 2027 Diversity Visa Program (green card lottery), which was previously suspended. The court's stay leaves the program halted while litigation continues, affecting approximately 55,000 visa slots. The ruling is a setback for applicants hoping to participate in the 2027 diversity visa lottery, as the court found merit in arguments against the program's reopening.

items.title: Tech stock meltdown wipes out $1 trillion in market value
items.feedTitle: Tech stock meltdown could get a lot of worse if history is any guide
items.summary: U.S. stock markets experienced a sharp sell-off, with technology stocks leading declines that erased approximately $1 trillion in market value. The Nasdaq suffered its worst day since June as investors dumped big tech shares amid concerns that massive AI spending by tech giants may not generate returns quickly enough. The sell-off reflects growing skepticism about the sustainability of the AI spending boom despite record capex outlays.

items.title: North Korea blamed for record $6.3 billion Binance crypto hack
items.feedTitle: North Korea is likely culprit behind $6.3bn crypto hack, ‘largest heist in history’
items.summary: The FBI has attributed the $6.3 billion theft from cryptocurrency exchange Binance to North Korea, marking the largest crypto heist in history. Binance says it has located and frozen about $3 billion of the stolen assets and will cover 90% of customer losses. The attack highlights vulnerabilities in crypto platform security and underscores North Korea's reliance on cyber theft to fund its isolated economy.

items.title: U.S. economy grows faster than expected; inflation rises to 3.7%
items.feedTitle: US economy grows faster than expected but inflation rises to 3.7%
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded faster than expected in the third quarter according to Commerce Department data, but inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September. The mixed signals contrast sharply with a sharp deterioration in consumer sentiment as the midterm elections approach. The data suggests economic resilience even as inflation pressures persist above the Federal Reserve's target.

items.title: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady ahead of midterms
items.feedTitle: Fed holds interest rates steady in last decision before midterms
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at its final board meeting before the midterm elections, keeping rates at elevated pre-election levels. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh stated that politics played no role in the pause on rate hikes, despite inflation remaining above 3%. The decision maintains the fed funds rate in the higher range established over the past year.

items.title: Reliance expands fuel exports to Africa, Europe amid conflict
items.feedTitle: Reliance Industries expands fuel exports to Africa, Europe as West Asia conflict disrupts supplies
items.summary: Reliance Industries has expanded its fuel exports to African and European markets as geopolitical conflict in West Asia disrupts traditional supply chains. The company is leveraging regional supply disruptions to increase its market share in international energy markets. The expansion reflects Reliance's strategic positioning to capitalize on supply chain realignment.

Oil prices face regional geopolitical pressure from Iran tensions and Middle East conflict disruptions. Investors are rotating away from growth stocks toward treasuries and defensive sectors ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections and amid mounting questions about AI spending sustainability.

cards.title: Distinguishing What You Control
cards.insight: The Stoics taught that freedom lies in focusing on what is within your control—your judgments, desires, and actions—while accepting what lies outside: others' opinions, external events, market volatility. In times of crisis like market crashes or political upheaval, this distinction prevents needless suffering; panic over stock prices wastes the energy you could invest in your own decisions.
cards.takeaway: When facing uncertainty today—midterms, AI spending concerns, geopolitical tensions—list what you can actually control (your portfolio allocation, your response, your preparation) and consciously release worry about outcomes you cannot direct.

cards.title: Adversity as Training Ground
cards.insight: Marcus Aurelius and Epictetus viewed hardship not as punishment but as an opportunity to practice virtue. A market correction tests your equanimity; an election outcome tests your judgment; a technological disruption tests your adaptability. Each is a chance to strengthen your character rather than weaken it.
cards.takeaway: When confronted with loss or disappointment this week—whether financial, political, or personal—pause and ask: 'What virtue can I practice in response?' Resilience, clarity, or grace under uncertainty are developed through such trials, not in calm times.

cards.title: The Illusion of Permanence
cards.insight: Stoics reminded themselves that all things—empires, markets, lives—are temporary and subject to change. The tech boom and AI spending spree will not last forever; political configurations shift; fortunes rise and fall. This isn't pessimism but realism that frees you from over-attachment to any fleeting state.
cards.takeaway: This week, when you observe market swings, election anxiety, or tech volatility, mentally step back and ask: 'Will this matter in five years? What enduring values or principles should guide me regardless of this passing trend?'

cards.title: Wisdom Over Speed
cards.insight: Stoic practice emphasizes deliberation and measured response over reactive haste. When markets fall or news breaks, the impulse is to act urgently; Stoics counsel pausing to examine the situation clearly before responding. Clarity of judgment, not speed of action, is the mark of wisdom.
cards.takeaway: Before you trade, comment, or decide in response to today's headline—midterm outcome, market crash, or AI funding news—pause for a moment of reflection. Ask yourself: 'Am I reacting to fear or choosing based on principle?' The extra minute often prevents regret.

ai.title: OpenAI slashes funding target to $20 billion in latest round
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
ai.summary: OpenAI has reduced its fundraising target for its current funding round from $30 billion to $20 billion, signaling waning investor enthusiasm for AI startups. The move comes amid broader concerns about the sustainability of massive AI spending and mounting debt across the sector. The reduced target suggests investors are becoming more cautious about valuations and capital requirements for AI companies.

ai.title: Anthropic IPO filing reveals $80.7 billion loss despite growth
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic IPO: 1,300% Growth, $16.3 Billion in Revenue, and an $80.7 Billion Loss. Here Are the Numbers to Watch.
ai.summary: Anthropic's S-1 SEC filing for its planned Nasdaq IPO (ticker: ANT) reveals the AI company posted an $80.7 billion loss despite reporting 1,300% revenue growth to $16.3 billion. The losses underscore the capital-intensive nature of AI model development and deployment. Credit rating agencies are reportedly expecting Anthropic to receive a 'high junk' rating following the IPO, which could make future fundraising more expensive.

ai.title: Anthropic's Claude blocks game cloning and reverse-engineering
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic's Claude AI blocks video game cloning and reverse-engineering — sweeping new restrictions also hit legitimate developers and basic troubleshooting tasks
ai.summary: Anthropic has implemented sweeping new restrictions in its Claude AI model to prevent video game cloning and reverse-engineering. However, the updated usage policies also block legitimate developers and basic troubleshooting tasks, sparking concern among the broader developer community. The restrictions represent Anthropic's effort to prevent misuse while inadvertently limiting valid use cases.

ai.title: Google's Genie 4 world model impressive but short of AGI
ai.feedTitle: Google's new Genie 4 'world model' looks incredible — but the underlying reality is still a long way from AGI
ai.summary: Google has unveiled Genie 4, a new 'world model' AI system that can generate and simulate interactive environments. While the demonstrations appear impressive, experts caution that the underlying technology remains far from artificial general intelligence (AGI). The model represents progress in generative AI but does not represent a fundamental breakthrough toward human-level AI.

ai.title: Cracks emerging in AI spending boom amid debt and skepticism
ai.feedTitle: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
ai.summary: Signs of strain are appearing in the AI industry's massive spending spree, with mounting corporate debt, negative cash flow at major tech firms, and growing investor skepticism about returns on capital. Despite billions in investments in AI infrastructure, questions are mounting about the long-term viability of current spending levels. The challenges suggest the AI boom may face headwinds as investors demand evidence of profitability.
